objectives: Solve the Day 20 — Production-Grade II: Graphs and Streaming RAG exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercises
sections.body:
1. Add a `POST /ingest` endpoint to Project 2 that accepts a list of `{id, text}` documents and upserts them into the Chroma collection. Add input validation (max 100 docs per request, max 4KB per doc).

<details>
<summary>Hint</summary>
Use `collection.upsert(ids=..., documents=...)`. Validate with a Pydantic model and return `{"ingested": N}`.
</details>

2. Replace the in-memory `sessions` dict in Project 2 with Redis. Use `RPUSH` to append and `LRANGE` to read the last 4 entries. Add a 24-hour TTL on the session key.

<details>
<summary>Hint</summary>
`redis.asyncio.from_url(...)` gives you an async client. JSON-encode each turn before pushing. Set TTL with `EXPIRE` on each write.
</details>

3. Add a `review` recursion limit to Project 1: if the reviewer loops more than 3 times, return the last draft with a `review_failed: true` flag instead of erroring.

<details>
<summary>Hint</summary>
Pass `config={"recursion_limit": 12}` to `ainvoke` (each loop is 2 steps, so 12 = 6 drafts max). Catch `GraphRecursionError` and inspect the last state.
</details>
